name: Pedrajas de San Esteban (Spain)
description: Green field with a yellow diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Pedrajas de San Esteban (a book on red and a tree on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Pedrajas de San Esteban; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
